svg.aria-label: What a session's context holds, by role, 19–30 September
svg.title: What a session's context holds, by role, 19–30 September
svg.text: What a session's context holds, by role
Sessions started 19–30 Sep (954), after LIN-2896 cut LinearViewer's CLAUDE.md on 18 Sep. Each block's tokens times the turns that carry it, as a share of the summed per-turn window.
Bytes are converted at 2.6 a token, the ratio the extractor measures from window growth. Under 4% is left unattributed for any role; the supervisors
attribute up to 5% more than their window (prose tokenizes at more bytes a token than code), and those rows are scaled to 100%.
